verdict.rationale: The Connect API documents batch transaction sync with external_id idempotence and deduplication, so many entries can be written in one operation. The AGL also auto-books 95%+ of transactions without per-item work. However, the MCP server is read-only, so agents cannot act on many items through it. Missing for 10: documented user- or agent-driven bulk edit, recategorize, approve or delete across many existing items; batch endpoints beyond transaction sync (e.g. bulk bill approve/pay); hands-on or independent corroboration.
